title: Initiate then Read state transition
purpose: Cover association setup followed by a distinct confirmed Read operation, preserving request ordering and changing the invoke identifier between states.
expected_behavior: The first message establishes the MMS initiation path; the second presents a subsequent confirmed Read request with invoke identifier 2 and service choice 4.
constraints_preserved: The first TPKT length is 0x000e and the second is 0x0011; each matches its complete message.
Read is service index 4 in the supplied confirmed-service catalog.
The second request follows the initiation message and uses a distinct invoke identifier.
Nested length fields match their encoded contents.
issue_safety_notes: No issue evidence is supplied and no historical payload is reproduced; stateful sequencing is a safe structural analogue.
